name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-shriek-mansion-inside
title: Super Princess Peach - Shriek Mansion (Inside)
description:
One of the backgrounds found in Shriek Mansion, the third world of Super Princess Peach.

This includes two versions, one for the lighter purple and the other for a darker gray. Both use the same ExGFX files & Map16, but are just built differently.
